content: SQLite production (WAL mode default): busy_timeout pragma is mandatory - without it concurrent writers get SQLITE_BUSY immediately instead of retrying (recommended ~5s). WAL mode lets readers/writers not block each other but writers still serialize against each other. WAL writes go to a separate *.wal file, not the main db file - naive 'cp db.sqlite backup.sqlite' during hot operation misses uncommitted WAL pages and yields an inconsistent backup; must copy WAL+SHM alongside or use sqlite3_backup API / VACUUM INTO / Litestream (which itself needs periodic short write locks during WAL checkpoint).
